tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background and the inside of a frame: aged paper (cream-1) in Paper, deep-space navy (navy-12) in Tape. The ground every text colour is checked on.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: The ground behind dithered backgrounds and pictures, and sunken wells (cream-2 / navy-12). ink and ink-muted stay legible on it.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Same colour as haze; the fill that replaces outlines on controls: text fields, select, the secondary button, the segmented strip, switch track, checkbox and radio boxes. ink 8.2:1 / 9.1:1 and ink-muted 5.2:1 / 4.9:1 on it; signal and vhs-red are not text here.

tokens.name: haze
tokens.usage: Dither tier 1, the lightest (backgrounds and pictures) and unlit progress cells (iris-3 in Paper, navy-11 in Tape). The same colour fills controls through control. Decorative, never text.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Dither tier 2, the deepest a background goes; the hover fill of every control-filled control (secondary button, segment, switch track, checkbox and radio box, select row); selected-row tint (iris-5 in Paper, navy-10 in Tape). ink stays 6.0:1 / 5.7:1 on it. Never text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Frame edges (the marked frame at stroke-frame; the plain frame, and so the notice, at stroke-hairline) and table row rules (iris-6 in Paper, navy-8 in Tape). Decorative only (2.0:1 in Paper). Frames are the only boxes drawn with lines; controls are fills.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Dither tier 3 (pictures only), the primary button fill, a field's bottom rule on hover and focus, checked and switched-on fills, the chosen row of an open select, the IRIS emphasis tag, lit progress cells, the INFO tag, links, the blue band of the VHS stripe and the focus ring: iris-9 in Paper (4.9:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on field), iris-7 in Tape (5.2:1). Not text on control (4.1:1 / 3.6:1).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a signal fill — the primary button's label, the check in a checkbox, the chosen row of an open select; 5.1:1 in Paper, 5.2:1 in Tape.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, numerals, icons and the plus marks of a frame, the switch thumb when on, and dither tier 4, the deepest (pictures only); iris-11 in Paper (9.9:1 on paper, 9.3:1 on field), cream-2 in Tape (13.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Unit labels (DAYS, HOURS), field labels, hints, placeholders and secondary text, a field's bottom rule at rest, the switch thumb when off, the select chevron and the rule under a table head. iris-10 in Paper: 6.3:1 on paper, 5.9:1 on field, 5.2:1 on control. warm-gray-6 in Tape: 7.0:1 on paper, 4.9:1 on control (warm-gray-7 falls to 3.6:1 there).

tokens.name: vhs-red
tokens.usage: Errors: the ERROR tag fill, error text on paper and field (5.1:1 / 4.9:1), an invalid field's bottom rule (stroke-focus thick); also the RED emphasis tag and the top band of the VHS stripe. signal-red-9 in Paper, signal-red-7 in Tape.

tokens.name: vhs-amber
tokens.usage: The AMBER emphasis tag fill (label in on-vhs-amber) and the middle band of the VHS stripe (amber-7). Never text and never a state — warnings use amber.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warnings: the WARN tag fill and warning text on paper and field (6.1:1 / 5.8:1). amber-10 in Paper, amber-6 in Tape. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Success and info, the CRT green-cyan: the OK tag fill and success text on paper and field (5.8:1 / 5.4:1); also the CYAN emphasis tag. cyan-10 in Paper, cyan-7 in Tape.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: The label on a vhs-red, amber or phosphor tag fill, state or emphasis: 4.9:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: on-vhs-amber
tokens.usage: The label on a vhs-amber tag fill: navy-12 in both themes, 5.1:1 — dark type on an amber cassette label.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Category 1 of the cassette palette, iris (iris-9 / iris-8). Chart series and segmented progress cells, always in this order and always with a legend or direct label: colour names which thing, never how good it is.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Category 2, amber (amber-8) — the deeper step of the VHS amber, so it holds 3:1 on paper in both themes. Same order rule as series-1.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Category 3, cyan (cyan-8) — the phosphor hue at a step that keeps its chroma. Same order rule as series-1.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Category 4, red (signal-red-9 / signal-red-8). Last on purpose: it echoes the error colour, so it appears only when there are four categories, and never means a state. A fifth category folds into an "Other" group or the chart splits — no fifth hue. The four pass the categorical checks (lightness band, chroma, colour-blind separation ≥ 12, 3:1 on paper) in both themes.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Sarasa Gothic SC", "Sarasa UI SC", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, "PingFang SC", monospace
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "Sarasa Gothic SC", "Sarasa UI SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.serif: "IBM Plex Serif", "Noto Serif SC", "Songti SC", SimSun, ui-serif, Georgia, serif

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Only where characters must line up or are machine text: figures, code, machine metadata — plus the state tag words and the wordmark.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Counters, statistics and times that change or must line up; always tabular, two digits, zero-padded.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, commands, paths, IDs, hashes and log lines — alone or inline in text. Never for a sentence meant for people.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Machine metadata: versions, build numbers, timestamps, byte counts, in ink-muted. Footnotes for people use text-small.

styles.name: compact-code
styles.usage: IDs, paths, durations and counts in compact rows (the compact step of code); tabular figures.

groups.name: Sans
groups.note: The main voice: every word meant for people. title, heading, tagline and label in capitals with wide tracking; ui-heading and text in sentence case.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The one line above a frame. Capitals, wide tracking.

styles.name: ui-heading
styles.usage: Headings inside dense product UI (panels, dialogs, settings), sentence case. Page sections use heading.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: The one statement under a frame, ending in a full stop. Capitals, wide tracking.

styles.name: text
styles.sample: The agent resumes from its last checkpoint and replays the tool calls it had not confirmed.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, descriptions, form help and button labels; the default for anything longer than one line.

styles.name: text-small
styles.sample: Stored locally. Cleared when the session closes.
styles.usage: Secondary interface text and field hints, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Unit labels under numerals and field labels, in ink-muted. Capitals; Chinese labels (天 时 分 秒) keep the same tracking.

groups.name: Serif
groups.note: The human voice, used sparingly: a statement, an introduction, a quotation. Never for UI.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: The work continues while you are away.
styles.usage: One editorial statement per page — a manifesto line, an announcement headline. Sentence case, full stop.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Lattice is an agent runtime that keeps its promises: every step recorded, every tool call accounted for.
styles.usage: The opening paragraph of a page or long document, above text.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: It did exactly what it said it would, and then it stopped.
styles.usage: Pull quotes and testimonials, with the attribution in label beneath. Chinese quotes stay upright in 「」 (there is no Chinese italic).

groups.name: Compact
groups.note: Product density: windows, panels, lists, logs, settings. Sentence case; capitals only for compact-label, tracked at 0.08em. Wide tracking (0.24–0.32em) stays with the expressive styles of 16px and up.

styles.name: compact-title
styles.usage: Panel and pane titles, the selected item's name; sentence case.

styles.name: compact-text
styles.usage: Everything else in a compact area: list rows, table cells, control labels, help.

styles.name: compact-label
styles.usage: Column heads, group labels and field labels in ink-muted; capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Compact only: the gap between a tag and its text, a compact label and its field, and the vertical padding of a compact table cell.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a numeral and its label, between a field label and its box, and between a control and its label; tag side padding; VHS stripe bands and gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact only: side padding of compact buttons and segments, and the inner padding of panels in a compact window.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side padding of buttons and inputs; with space-6, the 40px control height.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; gap between a frame and the lines above and below it; inside padding of a plain frame.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Inside padding of a marked frame; gap between counter cells.

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Height of every control and table row inside a compact area (.ls-compact); the expressive height stays space-6 + space-4 = 40px.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: frames, cards, every control, even the pixels of a glow. The system has no round shapes.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tiny marks only: tags, a caret.

tokens.name: stroke-frame
tokens.usage: The marked frame's edges in line and its plus marks in ink.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: The plain frame's continuous border in line, a field's bottom rule (ink-muted, signal on hover and focus) and table rules.

tokens.name: mark-arm
tokens.usage: Arm length of a frame's plus marks, and the break between each mark and the edges (1:1).

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring in signal, offset 2px in paper; also an invalid field's bottom rule in vhs-red.

dither.note: Light and pictures are ordered dither: square pixels on one page-wide grid, tone by density and tier only — no blur, no opacity, no gradient. Backgrounds use tiers haze and glow; pictures may use all four.

tokens.name: dither-pixel
tokens.usage: The side of one dither pixel and the pitch of the page-wide grid (Bayer 4x4, so the matrix repeats every 8px). Also the gap between progress cells.
